message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# https://github.com/technote-space/toc-generator
name: README_CHANGELOG_TOC2
on:
  push:
    branches: master
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate TOC
        uses: technote-space/toc-generator@v4
        with:
          # Fichiers/Globs à cibler
          TARGET_PATHS: |
            README.md
            CHANGELOG.md
            docs/**/*.md
          # Options utiles
          # GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # MAX_HEADER_LEVEL: 6
          # MIN_HEADER_LEVEL: 2",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured CI workflow evidence on forks showing elapsed savings when adding timeout-minutes to jobs (26.82% and 9.79% in the cited experiment cases). The repository has representative successful CI history, and this workflow is a fast, single-job checkout plus TOC generation with no existing timeout, so a 5-minute bound provides operational headroom without risking valid slow runs. The change is minimal, preserves all existing steps and coverage, and adds no permissions, secrets, network access, or deployment/publishing behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
